name: Pre-G Fixing / Hydrolysis Tank
identityStatus: PFD-listed tag/group mapped to modeled equipment identity
processFunction: Receives the F-160 cake (≈ 1.38 t, 60% acid liquor) and 8 t of water; reslurry and 1–2 h hold for gallery release (Route 6, R6-3 / R6-5); feeds F-161 via P-164

design.materialOfConstruction: Dual-laminate FRP (PVDF/ECTFE liner + VE-novolac) to ASME RTP-1
design.jacketProvision: A jacket on a 110 m³ HDPE tank is impractical and unnecessary at +17 K; the hazard is local boiling at the addition point (F-08)

operatingEnvelope.feedTemperatureC: 10–20 °C (R-141 cooled, PFD) vs 80 °C hot transfer per REP-040 (+2.4 K in T-161); water in at ≤ 28 °C keeps T-161 < 50 °C
operatingEnvelope.settleDecantBasis: Pilot 3 cycles × 3.5 h do not transfer — Stokes settling scales with tank depth (≈ 5 m commercial); decant is dilution washing (F-12)

reviewFindings: Approved tank, filter, dryer, transfer and vacuum-package datasheets are unavailable.
Materials, filter media, seals, trays and product-contact finishes are unapproved.
P&ID tags, sequences, alarms, trips, relief and vacuum safeguards are unresolved.
Wash endpoint, filtration cycle, cake moisture and dryer endpoint are unresolved.
Only the baseline FEED arrangement is promoted; dryer, enclosed and integrated layouts remain mutually exclusive design studies.
RO water, wastewater, vent, condensate, thermal and dry-product battery limits require approved sources.

identity.designConcept: Route 6 (REP-039; REP-042 Option C): the Pre-G GIC is filtered from the ≈ 90 wt % R-141 acid in F-160 before any water and the acid goes to recovery; T-161 hydrolyses and holds the reslurried cake in 8 t of water with no cooled loop (E-161, P-162 and T-162 deleted); gated on M4, with Option B (FEED-PE-CAL-016 V1.1) as the fallback
